% Pictures with no .xbb file in a document with TikZ, pict2e, and hyperref,
% whose pictures dvisvgm draws: an overpic with plain, italic, and math
% labels, a LaTeX picture that holds an \includegraphics, and a TikZ node
% that holds one. Each one builds at its size in the PDF, with its labels
% in its image. The last node's picture has its .xbb file, and is sized
% from it. The page ends with a plain \includegraphics of a PNG without its
% .xbb file, outside any picture.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{overpic}
\usepackage{pict2e}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\setlength{\fboxsep}{0pt}
\begin{document}
\section{Drawn}
\begin{overpic}[width=0.5\textwidth]{test-overpic-box.pdf}
\put(0,0){\rule{\width}{0.4pt}}\put(0,0){\rule{0.4pt}{\height}}
\put(10,10){P}
\put(50,50){\textit{Q} $y^2$}
\end{overpic}
After overpic.

\setlength{\unitlength}{1pt}
\begin{picture}(80,60)
\put(0,0){\fbox{\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}}}
\put(10,10){R}
\end{picture}
After picture.

\begin{tikzpicture}
\node[inner sep=0] (p) {\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-overpic-box.pdf}};
\node at (p.center) {S};
\end{tikzpicture}
After node.

\begin{tikzpicture}
\node[inner sep=0] (p) {\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-picture.png}};
\node at (p.center) {T};
\end{tikzpicture}
After found.

\includegraphics[width=80pt]{test-overpic-hidpi.png}
After plain.
\end{document}
